`final class SnapshotSettings`<br/>
**Package:** `dev.joid.test.snapshot` · **Module:** `tool-testkit` · **Source:** [SnapshotSettings.java](https://github.com/Zeldown/JOID/blob/main/tool/testkit/src/main/java/dev/joid/test/snapshot/SnapshotSettings.java)

The system properties of a snapshot run: where the references and the renders go, and whether the references are recorded.

## Learn more

- [References and the report](/build/testing-a-backend/#references-and-the-report)

<a id="SnapshotSettings-methods"></a>

## Methods

| Returns | Signature | Summary |
|---|---|---|
| `boolean` | [isUpdate](#SnapshotSettings-method-isUpdate)() <span class="joid-qualifier">static</span> | If `true`, the property `joid.snapshot.update` is set: every render replaces its reference. |
| `boolean` | [isRecord](#SnapshotSettings-method-isRecord)() <span class="joid-qualifier">static</span> | If `true`, the property `joid.snapshot.record` is set: a shot without a reference becomes its reference. |
| `File` | [getOutput](#SnapshotSettings-method-getOutput)() <span class="joid-qualifier">static</span> | Returns the folder of the renders and of the report, `joid.snapshot.output`, `build/snapshots/renders` by default. |
| `File` | [getReferences](#SnapshotSettings-method-getReferences)() <span class="joid-qualifier">static</span> | Returns the folder of the references, `joid.snapshot.references`, `.snapshots/references` by default. |

## Method details

<a id="SnapshotSettings-method-isUpdate"></a>

### isUpdate

`boolean isUpdate()` <span class="joid-qualifier">static</span>

If `true`, the property `joid.snapshot.update` is set: every render replaces its reference.

<a id="SnapshotSettings-method-isRecord"></a>

### isRecord

`boolean isRecord()` <span class="joid-qualifier">static</span>

If `true`, the property `joid.snapshot.record` is set: a shot without a reference becomes its reference.

<a id="SnapshotSettings-method-getOutput"></a>

### getOutput

`File getOutput()` <span class="joid-qualifier">static</span>

Returns the folder of the renders and of the report, `joid.snapshot.output`, `build/snapshots/renders` by default.

<a id="SnapshotSettings-method-getReferences"></a>

### getReferences

`File getReferences()` <span class="joid-qualifier">static</span>

Returns the folder of the references, `joid.snapshot.references`, `.snapshots/references` by default.
